readability.evidence: Clear names (content, renderValue, redactArray, isSensitiveKey, containsBearerCredential, scrub), small focused methods in app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:73-157, useful docblocks on the class and non-obvious helpers, and no dead code or debug output; the Pest cases read cleanly.

scope.evidence: Every changed file serves the task: the notifier in app/Ops, services/logging config, .env.example and phpunit.xml, docs/ops/logging.md plus the devops link and CHANGELOG entry, and the two Ops test files; no unrelated refactors or features.

issues.explanation: The channel tests compare env-backed values with strict toBe(14)/toBe(90), but phpunit.xml:29 pins only LOG_STACK; if a local or CI .env copied from .env.example:20-22 sets LOG_DAILY_DAYS or LOG_AUDIT_DAYS, env() returns strings and these assertions fail, reintroducing the local-.env dependency the task removed.

The 'audit channel accepts writes' test performs the write but its only assertion is expect(true)->toBeTrue(), so it proves nothing beyond 'did not throw' and never checks that the entry reached the audit channel.
The test writes to the real storage/logs/audit file instead of faking or spying the channel, which can leave rotated log artifacts and couples the test to the filesystem.

review.summary: The change adds App\Ops\DiscordOpsAlert (config-driven Discord POST, redaction, 1800-character truncation and soft-fail logging), introduces the 90-day audit channel, switches the default stack to daily, pins the test environment, and documents the three lanes with Pest coverage. It meets the task contract and the applicable conventions with clean, scoped code. The overall score is 4 (approve with nits) because the logging tests contain a tautological audit-write assertion and strict env-backed integer assertions that can fail with a local .env.
